what: United Arab Emirates to quit oil cartel Opec

clean_source_blocks.text: The United Arab Emirates has announced that it's leaving OPEC, the cartel representing major state-owned oil producers, on May 1.
The UAE leaving Opec is seen as a major blow and potential death knell for the oil cartel.
The United Arab Emirates has quit the Opec oil cartel in a heavy blow to the group and its de facto leader, Saudi Arabia, amid the global energy shock caused by the Iran war.
The United Arab Emirates (UAE) is quitting the Opec and Opec+ groups of major oil producing nations next month after nearly 60 years of membership.

packet.source_text:
The United Arab Emirates has announced that it's leaving OPEC, the cartel representing major state-owned oil producers, on May 1.

The UAE leaving Opec is seen as a major blow and potential death knell for the oil cartel.

The United Arab Emirates (UAE) is quitting the Opec and Opec+ groups of major oil producing nations next month after nearly 60 years of membership.
